sentences.zh: 越七年，郡縣上其事，詔建特祠，賜額貞烈。

translations.literal: Seven years later the prefecture and county reported the matter. An edict ordered a special shrine built and conferred the title "Chaste and Heroic."
translations.idiomatic: Seven years later the prefecture and county reported the matter. An edict ordered a special shrine built and conferred the title Chaste and Heroic.

sentences.zh: 石門丐婦，湖州人，莫詳其姓氏。

translations.literal: The beggar woman of Shimen—a native of Huzhou; her surname is not clearly known.
translations.idiomatic: The beggar woman of Shimen was a native of Huzhou; her surname is not clearly known.

sentences.zh: 正德中，湖大饑，婦隨其夫及姑走崇德石門市乞食。

translations.literal: During Zhengde, Huzhou suffered great famine. The woman followed her husband and mother-in-law to Chongde, to Shimen market, to beg food.
translations.idiomatic: During the Zhengde reign, Huzhou suffered a great famine. The woman followed her husband and mother-in-law to Shimen market in Chongde to beg for food.

sentences.zh: 三人偶相失。

translations.literal: The three accidentally became separated.
translations.idiomatic: The three were accidentally separated.

sentences.zh: 婦有色，市人爭挑之。

translations.literal: The woman was attractive; men in the market contended to harass her.
translations.idiomatic: The woman was attractive, and men in the market contended to harass her.

sentences.zh: 與之食不顧，誘之財亦不顧。

translations.literal: Offer her food—she ignored it. Tempt her with wealth—she also ignored it.
translations.idiomatic: Offer her food and she ignored it. Tempt her with wealth and she ignored that too.

sentences.zh: 寓東高橋上，不復乞食者二日。

translations.literal: She lodged on East High Bridge and for two days did not beg for food again.
translations.idiomatic: She lodged on East High Bridge and for two days did not beg for food again.

sentences.zh: 伺夫與姑皆不至，聚觀者益眾，婦乃從橋上躍入水中死。

translations.literal: Waiting until neither husband nor mother-in-law came, the crowd of onlookers growing ever larger, the woman then leaped from the bridge into the water and died.
translations.idiomatic: When neither her husband nor her mother-in-law appeared, the crowd of onlookers only grew larger. The woman then leaped from the bridge into the water and died.

sentences.zh: 賈氏，慶雲諸生陳俞妻。

translations.literal: Lady Jia, wife of Chen Yu, a licentiate of Qingyun.
translations.idiomatic: Lady Jia was the wife of Chen Yu, a licentiate of Qingyun.

sentences.zh: 正德六年，兵變，值舅病卒，家人挽之避，痛哭曰：「舅尚未斂，婦何惜一死。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Zhengde, a military mutiny broke out. Just then her uncle-by-marriage fell ill and died. Her family urged her to flee for safety. Weeping, she said: "My uncle has not yet been encoffined—why should I grudge one death?
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of Zhengde, a military mutiny broke out. Just then her uncle-by-marriage fell ill and died. Her family urged her to flee for safety. Weeping, she said, "My uncle has not yet been encoffined—why should I grudge a single death?

sentences.zh: 」身服斬衰不解。

translations.literal: " She wore zhan mourning garments and did not remove them.
translations.idiomatic: " She wore the heaviest mourning garments and did not remove them.

sentences.zh: 兵至，縱火迫之出，罵不絕口，刃及身無完膚，與舅屍同燼。

translations.literal: When the soldiers arrived, they set fire to force her out. She cursed without cease; blades reached her body until no patch of skin was whole. She perished in the flames together with her uncle's corpse.
translations.idiomatic: When the soldiers arrived, they set fire to force her out. She cursed without cease as blades cut her body until not a patch of skin was whole. She perished in the flames together with her uncle's corpse.

sentences.zh: 年二十五。

translations.literal: She was twenty-five years old.
translations.idiomatic: She was twenty-five years old.

sentences.zh: 鄞縣諸生李珂妻胡氏，年十八歸珂。

translations.literal: Lady Hu, wife of Li Ke, a licentiate of Yin County, married Ke at age eighteen.
translations.idiomatic: Lady Hu was the wife of Li Ke, a licentiate of Yin County. She married him at eighteen.

sentences.zh: 閱七年，珂死，遺男女各一，胡誓不逾閾。

translations.literal: After seven years, Ke died, leaving one son and one daughter. Hu vowed never to cross the threshold.
translations.idiomatic: Seven years later Ke died, leaving one son and one daughter. Hu vowed never to remarry.

sentences.zh: 鄰火作，珂兄珮往救之，曰：「阿姆來，吾乃出。

translations.literal: A fire broke out next door. Ke's elder brother Pei went to rescue her, saying: "When Aunt comes, I will come out.
translations.idiomatic: A fire broke out next door. Ke's elder brother Pei went to rescue her, saying, "When you come out, Aunt, I will too.

sentences.zh: 」珮使妻陳往，婦以七歲男自牖付之，屬曰：「幸念吾夫，善視之。

translations.literal: " Pei sent his wife Chen. The widow handed her seven-year-old son out through the window, entrusting him: "Please remember my husband and treat him well.
translations.idiomatic: " Pei sent his wife Chen. The widow handed her seven-year-old son out through the window and entrusted him, saying, "Please remember my husband and care for him well.

sentences.zh: 」陳曰：「嬸將何如？

translations.literal: " Chen said: "Sister-in-law, what will you do?
translations.idiomatic: " Chen said, "Sister-in-law, what will you do?

sentences.zh: 」紿之曰：「取少首飾即出。

translations.literal: " She deceived her, saying: "I am just fetching a few pieces of jewelry and will come out.
translations.idiomatic: " She deceived her, saying, "I am just fetching a few pieces of jewelry and will come out right away.

sentences.zh: 」陳去，胡即累衣箱塞戶，抱三歲女端坐火中死。

translations.literal: " After Chen left, Hu piled clothing chests to block the door, held her three-year-old daughter, and sat upright in the fire until she died.
translations.idiomatic: " After Chen left, Hu piled clothing chests to block the door, held her three-year-old daughter, and sat upright in the flames until she died.

sentences.zh: 陳宗球妻史氏，南安人。

translations.literal: Lady Shi, wife of Chen Zongqiu, a native of Nan'an.
translations.idiomatic: Lady Shi was the wife of Chen Zongqiu and a native of Nan'an.

sentences.zh: 夫死將殉有期矣，尚為姑釀酒。

translations.literal: Her husband had died and the day for her to follow him in death was already set, yet she still brewed wine for her mother-in-law.
translations.idiomatic: Her husband had died and the day she would follow him in death was already set, yet she still brewed wine for her mother-in-law.

sentences.zh: 姑曰：「婦已決死，生存豈多日，何辛苦為？

translations.literal: The mother-in-law said: "Daughter-in-law, you have resolved to die—how many days of life remain? Why take such trouble?
translations.idiomatic: Her mother-in-law said, "Daughter-in-law, you have already resolved to die—how many days of life can remain? Why go to such trouble?

sentences.zh: 」曰：「政為日短，故釀而奉姑。

translations.literal: " She said: "Precisely because the days are few, I brew wine to serve you.
translations.idiomatic: " She said, "Precisely because my days are few, I brew wine to serve you.

sentences.zh: 」將死，告舅曰：「婦有喪，幸毋髹棺。

translations.literal: " When about to die, she told her uncle-in-law: "I am in mourning—please do not lacquer the coffin.
translations.idiomatic: " When she was about to die, she told her uncle-in-law, "I am in mourning—please do not lacquer the coffin.

sentences.zh: 」遂縊。

translations.literal: " Then she hanged herself.
translations.idiomatic: " Then she hanged herself.

sentences.zh: 葉氏，定海人。

translations.literal: Lady Ye, a native of Dinghai.
translations.idiomatic: Lady Ye was a native of Dinghai.

sentences.zh: 許聘慈谿翁姓，而父母俱歿，遂育於翁。

translations.literal: Betrothed to a man surnamed Weng of Cixi; as both parents had died, she was raised in the Weng household.
translations.idiomatic: She was betrothed to a man surnamed Weng of Cixi. As both her parents had died, she was raised in the Weng household.

sentences.zh: 年十四，翁資產日落，且失其姑，舅待之如奴，勞勚萬狀，略無怨色。

translations.literal: At fourteen, the Weng family's assets dwindled day by day, and her aunt-in-law also died. Her uncle-by-marriage treated her like a slave; she toiled in countless ways with scarcely a trace of resentment.
translations.idiomatic: At fourteen, the Weng family's assets dwindled day by day, and her aunt-in-law also died. Her uncle-by-marriage treated her like a slave. She toiled in countless ways, yet showed scarcely a trace of resentment.

sentences.zh: 舅以子幼，欲鬻之羅姓者，葉恚曰：「我非貨也，何輾轉貿易為？

translations.literal: Because his son was young, the uncle wished to sell her off to the Luo family. Ye indignantly said: "I am not merchandise—why pass me about in trade?
translations.idiomatic: Because his son was still young, the uncle wished to sell her off to the Luo family. Ye said in indignation, "I am not merchandise—why should I be passed about in trade?

sentences.zh: 」日哽咽垂涕。

translations.literal: " Day by day she choked back tears.
translations.idiomatic: " Day after day she choked back tears.

sentences.zh: 既知不可免，偽為喜色，舅遂寬之。

translations.literal: Once she knew there was no escape, she feigned a glad expression, and her uncle relaxed his guard.
translations.idiomatic: Once she knew there was no escape, she feigned a glad expression, and her uncle relaxed his guard.

sentences.zh: 夜月上，紿諸姒曰：「月色甚佳，盍少猶夷乎？

translations.literal: When the moon rose at night, she deceived her sisters-in-law, saying: "The moonlight is lovely—shall we linger a little?
translations.idiomatic: When the moon rose at night, she deceived her sisters-in-law, saying, "The moonlight is lovely—shall we linger a little?

sentences.zh: 」趨門外良久。

translations.literal: " She went outside the gate and stayed a long while.
translations.idiomatic: " She went outside the gate and stayed a long while.

sentences.zh: 諸姒並勸曰：「夜既半矣，盍就寢。

translations.literal: The sisters-in-law all urged her: "The night is already half gone—shall we not go to bed?
translations.idiomatic: The sisters-in-law all urged her, "The night is already half gone—shall we not go to bed?

sentences.zh: 」遂入，及晨覓之，則氏已浮屍於河矣，起之色如生。

translations.literal: " She then came in. When they searched at dawn, Lady Ye's body was already floating in the river; when raised, her color was as though alive.
translations.idiomatic: " She then came in. When they searched at dawn, Lady Ye's body was already floating in the river. When it was raised, her color was as though she were still alive.

sentences.zh: 胡貴貞，樂平人。

translations.literal: Hu Guizhen, a native of Leping.
translations.idiomatic: Hu Guizhen was a native of Leping.

sentences.zh: 生時，父母欲不舉，其鄰曾媼救之歸，與子天福同乳，欲俟其長而配焉。

translations.literal: At birth her parents wished not to raise her. A neighbor, Old Woman Zeng, rescued and took her home, nursed her together with her son Tianfu on the same milk, intending to marry her to him when they grew up.
translations.idiomatic: At birth her parents wished not to raise her. A neighbor, Old Woman Zeng, rescued her and took her home. She nursed her together with her son Tianfu, intending to marry the two when they grew up.

sentences.zh: 天福年十八，父母繼亡，家甚落。

translations.literal: Tianfu was eighteen; his parents died one after another, and the household declined greatly.
translations.idiomatic: Tianfu was eighteen when his parents died one after another, and the household fell into great decline.

sentences.zh: 貴貞父將奪以姻富家，女曰：「我鞠於曾，婦於曾，分姑媳，恩母子，可以饑寒棄之邪？

translations.literal: Guizhen's father was about to take her away to marry her into a rich family. The girl said: "I was raised by the Zengs; as a wife I belong to the Zengs—we are mother-in-law and daughter-in-law in role, mother and son in affection. How can I be cast off for hunger and cold?
translations.idiomatic: Guizhen's father was about to take her away and marry her into a rich family. The girl said, "I was raised by the Zengs; as a wife I belong to the Zengs. In role we are mother-in-law and daughter-in-law; in affection we are mother and son. How can I be cast off for hunger and cold?

sentences.zh: 」乃依從姑以居，蓽舍單淺，外人未嘗識其面。

translations.literal: " So she went to live with a paternal aunt; her thatched hut was crude and sparse, and outsiders never once saw her face.
translations.idiomatic: " So she went to live with a paternal aunt. Her thatched hut was crude and sparse, and outsiders never once saw her face.

sentences.zh: 其兄乘天福未婚，曳以歸，出視求聘者金寶笄飾。

translations.literal: Her elder brother, taking advantage of Tianfu's unmarried state, dragged her home and displayed the gold, jewels, and hair ornaments of suitors seeking her hand.
translations.idiomatic: Her elder brother, taking advantage of Tianfu's unmarried state, dragged her home and displayed the gold, jewels, and hair ornaments offered by suitors.

sentences.zh: 女知不免，潛入房縊死。

translations.literal: Knowing there was no escape, she secretly entered a room and hanged herself.
translations.idiomatic: Knowing there was no escape, she secretly entered a room and hanged herself.

sentences.zh: 孫氏，吳縣衛廷珪妻。

translations.literal: Lady Sun, wife of Wei Tinggui of Wu County.
translations.idiomatic: Lady Sun was the wife of Wei Tinggui of Wu County.

sentences.zh: 隨夫商販，寓潯陽小江口。

translations.literal: She followed her husband in trade and lodged at Xiaojiangkou in Xunyang.
translations.idiomatic: She followed her husband in trade and lodged at Xiaojiangkou in Xunyang.

sentences.zh: 寧王陷九江，廷珪適他往，所親急邀孫共逃。

translations.literal: When the Prince of Ning captured Jiujiang, Tinggui happened to be away elsewhere. Their relatives urgently invited Sun to flee together.
translations.idiomatic: When the Prince of Ning captured Jiujiang, Tinggui happened to be away. Their relatives urgently urged Sun to flee with them.

sentences.zh: 孫謂兩女金蓮、玉蓮曰：「我輩異鄉人，汝父不在，逃將安之？

translations.literal: Sun said to her two daughters Jinlian and Yulian: "We are strangers here; your father is absent—where would we flee to?
translations.idiomatic: Sun said to her two daughters Jinlian and Yulian, "We are strangers here, and your father is absent—where would we flee to?

sentences.zh: 今賊已劫鄰家矣，奈何？

translations.literal: The rebels have already looted the neighbor's house—what is to be done?
translations.idiomatic: The rebels have already looted the neighbor's house—what is to be done?

sentences.zh: 」女曰：「生死不相離，要當為父全此身耳。

translations.literal: " The daughters said: "In life or death we will not part—we must preserve our bodies intact for Father's sake.
translations.idiomatic: " The daughters said, "In life or death we will not part—we must preserve our bodies intact for Father's sake.

sentences.zh: 」於是母子共一長繩自束，赴河死。

translations.literal: " Thereupon mother and daughters bound themselves together with one long rope and went into the river to die.
translations.idiomatic: " Thereupon mother and daughters bound themselves together with one long rope and went into the river to die.

sentences.zh: 江氏，余幹夏璞妻。

translations.literal: Lady Jiang, wife of Xia Pu of Yugan.
translations.idiomatic: Lady Jiang was the wife of Xia Pu of Yugan.

sentences.zh: 正德間，賊至，抱方晬弟走，不得脫。

translations.literal: During the Zhengde reign, bandits arrived. She fled carrying her one-year-old younger brother but could not escape.
translations.idiomatic: During the Zhengde reign, bandits arrived. She fled carrying her one-year-old younger brother but could not escape.

sentences.zh: 賊將縛之，曰：「誠願與將軍俱，顧吾父年老，惟一弟，幸得全之。

translations.literal: As the bandits were about to bind her, she said: "I truly wish to go with the general, but my father is old and I have only this one brother—please spare him.
translations.idiomatic: As the bandits were about to bind her, she said, "I truly wish to go with the general, but my father is old and I have only this one brother—please spare him.

sentences.zh: 」賊以為信，縱令置所抱兒，出遂大聲罵賊，投橋下死。

translations.literal: " The bandits believed her, released her, and let her set down the child she was carrying. Once outside, she loudly cursed the bandits and threw herself beneath the bridge to her death.
translations.idiomatic: " The bandits believed her, released her, and let her set down the child she was carrying. Once outside, she loudly cursed the bandits and threw herself beneath the bridge to her death.

sentences.zh: 後隆慶中，有高明嚴氏，賊掠其境，隨兄出避，遇賊，刃及其兄。

translations.literal: Later, in the Longqing reign, there was Lady Yan of Gaoming. When bandits raided her district, she fled with her elder brother, encountered the bandits, and a blade struck her brother.
translations.idiomatic: Later, during the Longqing reign, there was Lady Yan of Gaoming. When bandits raided her district, she fled with her elder brother, encountered the bandits, and a blade struck her brother.

sentences.zh: 女跪泣曰：「父早喪，孀母堅守，恃此一兄，殺之則祀殄矣，請以身代。

translations.literal: The girl knelt weeping and said: "My father died early; my widowed mother keeps steadfast vigil. She relies on this one brother alone—if you kill him, our ancestral offerings will end. I beg you to take my life instead.
translations.idiomatic: The girl knelt weeping and said, "My father died early; my widowed mother keeps steadfast vigil. She relies on this one brother alone—if you kill him, our ancestral offerings will end. I beg you to take my life instead.

sentences.zh: 」賊憫然為納刃。

translations.literal: " The bandits were moved and sheathed their blades.
translations.idiomatic: " The bandits were moved and sheathed their blades.

sentences.zh: 既而欲汙之，則曰：「請釋吾兄即配汝。

translations.literal: Later, when they wished to defile her, she said: "Release my brother and I will marry you.
translations.idiomatic: Later, when they wished to defile her, she said, "Release my brother and I will marry you.

sentences.zh: 」及兄去，執不從，竟剖腹而死。

translations.literal: " After her brother had gone, she steadfastly refused. In the end she cut open her belly and died.
translations.idiomatic: " After her brother had gone, she steadfastly refused. In the end she cut open her belly and died.
